d: Expansive southern constellation containing the Alpha Centauri triple system and bright southern markers.

hip-71683.x: Primary G2V solar analogue of the Alpha Centauri binary, just 4.37 light-years from Earth.

hip-71681.x: Secondary K1V dwarf in the Alpha Centauri binary, orbiting in a mutual 79.9-year gravitational dance.

gaia-5853498713190525696.x: Nearest known star to our Solar System (4.24 ly), an active red dwarf hosting multiple terrestrial exoplanets.

hip-68702.x: Brilliant blue-white giant binary pointer star (390 ly), pairing with Rigil Kentaurus to indicate the Southern Cross.

hip-68933.x: Evolved orange giant star marking the northern head of the mythological Centaur.
